1.consolidated_definition: Disparate popular de diversos sentidos, y que indica generalmente lo caliente y buena que ha quedado una cosa, de manera que todo el mundo se moría de gusto. “Los jugadores respondían con una frase de aliento... —¡Éntrale a fondo! —¡Otra como esa! —¡Eso es moriquitirse!” González García, , p. 35.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Popular expression of diverse meanings, generally indicating that something has turned out well and is very good, to the point where everyone is extremely pleased. "The players responded with an encouraging phrase... —Go in deep! —Another like that one! —That's a real treat!" González García, p. 35.
